<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="rostrick-statusbar" content="color=#0A0914; icons=light; anim=200">
<meta name="rostrick-orientation" content="portrait">
<title>مكتبة الكوميكس</title>
<style>
:root {
  --primary: #6C3BFF;
  --primary-dark: #4A22C9;
  --accent: #00E5FF;
  --highlight: #FF3D7F;
  --control: #B8B5D1;
  --bg-deep: #090812;
  --bg-card: #131126;
  --bg-card-2: #1A1734;
  --border-glow: rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.35);
  --text-main: #F5F4FF;
  --text-muted: #9E9BBF;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background-color: var(--bg-deep);
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.5;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  min-height: 100%;
}

body {
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.18) 0%, transparent 45%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 85% 25%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12) 0%, transparent 40%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 50% 90%, rgba(255, 61, 127, 0.1) 0%, transparent 45%);
  padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top);
  padding-bottom: calc(82px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}

a {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

button, input, select {
  font-family: inherit;
}

/* Top App Bar */
.app-bar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  background: rgba(10, 9, 20, 0.92);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.3);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.app-bar-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.icon-btn {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(184, 181, 209, 0.2);
  background: rgba(26, 23, 52, 0.85);
  color: var(--text-main);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
  padding: 0;
}

.icon-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.93);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.icon-btn.accent-btn {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
  color: var(--accent);
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
}

.app-bar-titles {
  margin-right: 12px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.app-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.app-subtitle {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--control);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.app-bar-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.app-bar-actions .icon-btn {
  margin-right: 8px;
}

/* Main container */
.container {
  padding: 14px 14px 20px 14px;
  max-width: 960px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Search & Sort Row */
.search-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.search-box {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.4);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  height: 48px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.search-box:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.15);
}

.search-icon {
  color: var(--control);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-left: 8px;
}

.search-input {
  flex: 1;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  color: var(--text-main);
  font-size: 14px;
  min-width: 0;
  height: 100%;
}

.search-input::placeholder {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.clear-search {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border: none;
  background: rgba(184, 181, 209, 0.12);
  color: var(--control);
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
}

.clear-search.visible {
  display: inline-flex;
}

.sort-btn {
  margin-right: 8px;
  height: 48px;
  min-width: 48px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.4);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  color: var(--text-main);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}

.sort-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.sort-btn svg {
  margin-left: 6px;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* Filter Chips */
.chips-scroll {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  overflow-x: auto;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}

.chips-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.chip {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(184, 181, 209, 0.22);
  background: var(--bg-card);
  color: var(--control);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-left: 8px;
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}

.chip:last-child {
  margin-left: 0;
}

.chip:active {
  transform: scale(0.95);
}

.chip.active {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark));
  color: #FFFFFF;
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.55);
}

.chip.status-chip.active {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.22), rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.35));
  color: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
}

.chip-count {
  margin-right: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  padding: 1px 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
}

/* Continue Reading Spotlight */
.spotlight {
  display: none;
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.28), rgba(19, 17, 38, 0.95) 60%, rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18));
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45), 0 0 22px rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.22);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.spotlight.visible {
  display: block;
}

.spotlight-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--accent);
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.35);
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.spotlight-badge svg {
  margin-left: 5px;
}

.spotlight-body {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.spotlight-cover {
  width: 72px;
  height: 92px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  object-fit: cover;
  border: 2px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
  background: #0F0D1D;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-left: 12px;
}

.spotlight-info {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.spotlight-title {
  margin: 0 0 3px 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.spotlight-meta {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--control);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.progress-track {
  width: 100%;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary), var(--accent));
  transition: width 0.35s ease;
}

.progress-fill.done {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00E5FF, #38EF7D);
}

.spotlight-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.btn-primary {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  border: none;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark));
  color: #FFFFFF;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.45);
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, filter 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-primary:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
  filter: brightness(1.1);
}

.btn-primary svg {
  margin-left: 6px;
}

.btn-neon {
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--accent);
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.1);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-right: 8px;
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, background 0.2s ease;
}

.btn-neon:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
  background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.22);
}

.btn-neon svg {
  margin-left: 6px;
}

/* Section Header */
.section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.section-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-main);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.section-title-bar {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 4px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent), var(--highlight));
  margin-left: 8px;
}

.section-count {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--control);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Comics Grid (no flex/grid gap for Chromium 78 safety) */
.comics-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-left: -6px;
  margin-right: -6px;
}

.comic-col {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 6px 14px 6px;
}

@media (min-width: 600px) {
  .comic-col {
    width: 50%;
  }
}

.comic-card {
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(165deg, var(--bg-card-2), var(--bg-card));
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(108, 59, 255, 0.35);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 12px;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}

.comic-card:active {
  transform: scale(0.985);
}

.comic-card.is-reading {
  border-color: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.5);
}

.comic-card.is-completed {
  border-color: rgba(56, 239, 125, 0.45);
}

.comic-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.cover-wrap {
  position: relative;
  width: 92px;
  height: 118px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-left: 12px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(184, 181, 209, 0.22);
  background: #0D0B1A;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.cover-img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.pages-pill {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 5px;
  right: 5px;
  background: rgba(9, 8, 18, 0.86);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.45);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.comic-meta-col {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.comic-header-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.genre-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #FF8FB5;
  background: rgba(255, 61, 127, 0.14);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 61, 127, 0.35);
  padding: 2px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.fav-btn {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  min-width: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  margin-top: -8px;
  margin-left: -8px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--control);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 12px;
  transition: transform 0.14s ease, color 0.2s ease;
}

.fav-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.88);
}

.fav-btn.active {
  color: var(--highlight);
}

.comic-title {
  margin: 0 0 4px 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-main);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.comic-author {
  margin: 0 0 6px 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--control);
}

.comic-summary {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
